name: KY-012 active piezo buzzer
not_buildable: It sounds as soon as an output pin drives it. It is an output part, and LearnLens sketches may only switch the board's own LEDs so far.
identification: Small black PCB with 3 angled header pins at one end and a wide black cylinder with a hole in the top. The KY-006 passive buzzer looks the same.

facts.statement: The active buzzer sounds at 2.5 kHz while voltage is applied to its signal pin; operating voltage 3.3 V to 5 V, up to 30 mA.
